			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_need_r3_tt
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_r3 > 59.999 }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_SU_cost_martial_r }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_martial_reg_3_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_reg = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_d = -25 }
				COLDWAR_SU_add_region_n = yes
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SU_martial_r3_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_t_d = 15 }
				COLDWAR_SU_add_pressure = yes
				every_country = { limit = { NOT = { tag = ROOT } has_variable = mdcw_cw_alignment check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = COLDWAR_SU_op_m15 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tension } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 3 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
			}
			COLDWAR_SU_after_change = yes
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 3 check_variable = { COLDWAR_SU_r3 > 79.999 } }
		}
	}

		activation = { always = no }
		is_good = yes
		fire_only_once = yes
		days_mission_timeout = 1825
		timeout_effect = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_breaking_codes
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SU_codes_locked
			if = { limit = { original_tag = UKR } add_nuclear_bombs = 20 }
			if = { limit = { original_tag = KAZ } add_nuclear_bombs = 10 }
			if = { limit = { original_tag = BLR } add_nuclear_bombs = 3 }

	}
